**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

- No non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use covenant binds Bluefly anywhere in the Agreement — targeted searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "shall not develop" and "Customer shall not" surface nothing of the kind.
- § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) works in our favour: "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others."
- The two flagged candidates are benign: § 14.11 is a resale prohibition on IBM's own Services (a scope-of-use limit, not a restraint on our business lines, and addressed under the resale rule if at all), and § 13.2/§ 14.19 concern IBM's AUP amendment right and IBM's delivery geography respectively.

This sits at the preferred position, so nothing to redline.
